about: T11 retrieval pairs for weather (objects and probe observables) (plan v3.1 Appendix F: recall@8 ≥ 0.95 on ≥ 150 pairs, ≥ 20 per pack), asked of world.simulation-run.observables.search in the integrated fixture at 240 s (scripts/display-eval/retrieval.ts). Any one expectation among the top 8 matches is a hit.
